blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Sixth seed Leylah Fernandez scraped past Japanese qualifier Kyoka Okamura, 6-2, 5-3, to reach the second round of the Singapore Open on Monday night at OCBC Arena. The Canadian-Filipino needed to overcome a gutsy performance by Okamura, who’s ranked 307th. “I’m just glad to be playing in front of you guys, the Singaporean fans, [and] I know there’s a lot of Pinoy (Filipino) fans here, so salamat (thank you) for all the support, it truly means a lot to me,” said Fernandez, drawing a big roar from Filipino fans, who packed the 3,000-capacity indoor venue.
